# Next.fs — Full LLM Context

## What is Next.fs
Next.fs is a thin Fable binding layer for writing Next.js App Router applications in F#.
It stays close to native Next.js concepts and avoids introducing a parallel framework.

## Canonical links
- Docs home: https://neftedollar.com/Next.fs/
- Repository: https://github.com/Neftedollar/Next.fs
- NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/NextFs
